filename: T1 - Schwannoma of the hypoglossal nerve posterior fossa , brainstem 003.jpg
description: A hypodense well-circumscribed lesion inferiorly within the posterior fossa on the right elevates the cerebellar hemisphere and displaces the brainstem towards the left. A small focus of calcification is present that may be related to the mass or belong to normal choroid plexus. No hydrocephalus.
